task_title: Use the installing interpreter for wheel CLI bridge evaluation
task_criteria: With a wheel installed into a venv and the venv absent from PATH, absolute terminal-jail echo hi exits 0 with an allow rule_id and runs; rm -rf / remains blocked; explicit nonexistent interpreter fails loudly; --no-interruptor remains unchanged; regression test covers absolute-path unactivated-venv invocation.

items.criterion: With a wheel installed into a venv and the venv absent from PATH, absolute terminal-jail echo hi exits 0 with an allow rule_id and runs; rm -rf / remains blocked; explicit nonexistent interpreter fails loudly; --no-interruptor remains unchanged; regression test covers absolute-path unactivated-venv invocation.
items.detail: All five arms verified by running the regression class and by direct end-to-end probes against a synthetic installed venv (absolute console script, PATH = testbin only — no python3, no venv bin). Test run: `cd plugin && /usr/bin/python3 -m pytest test_packaging_wheel.py -k UnactivatedVenv -v` -> '5 passed, 12 deselected'; full suite `pytest plugin -q` -> '1925 passed, 12 skipped in 142.60s'. Direct probe output: (a) `--user echo tj-df061-allow` -> rc=0, stdout 'tj-df061-allow', verdict log {'action':'allow','rule_id':'allow-echo','layer':'yaml'} (plugin/test_packaging_wheel.py:470-484); (b) `rm -rf /` -> rc=126, 'COMMAND BLOCKED', 'builtin-rm-rf-root', no '[bridge-error]' (test_packaging_wheel.py:487-496); (c) TERMINAL_JAIL_PYTHON=<nonexistent>/python3 -> rc=126, 'line 334: .../nonexistent/python3: No such file or directory', payload 'tj-df061-must-not-run' absent from stdout (test_packaging_wheel.py:517-536); (d) `--user --no-interruptor echo tj-df061-noi` -> rc=0, payload printed, zero verdict log entries (test_packaging_wheel.py:499-515). Mechanism: plugin/terminal_jail/cli.py:70-76 exports sys.executable as TERMINAL_JAIL_PYTHON only when unset/empty (operator override wins, test_packaging_wheel.py:561-565), consumed by standalone/terminal-jail:279 `_TJ_BRIDGE_PY="${TERMINAL_JAIL_PYTHON:-python3}"` at lines 308/333/334/514/600/624. Negative control: disabling the cli.py export makes the class fail ('2 failed, 1 passed, 2 errors' — 'python3: command not found', 'COMMAND BLOCKED — interruptor-bridge-unavailable', KeyError 'TERMINAL_JAIL_PYTHON'), proving the test pins the fix rather than passing vacuously.
